title: Rappahannock River Charters

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Fish the Rappahannock River or the Chesapeake Bay. Fishing for up to seven people per vessel (total of 14). Book by half or full day. Fish for Spot, Croaker, Trout, Spanish Mackerel, Bluefish, Catfish, and Rockfish. Bait, Rods & Tackle Included: $599 1/2 day, up to six people - $799 full day, up to 6

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Take a breathtaking tour of Carters Creek and the Rappahannock River with a picturesque sunset. Navigated by Captain Saunders one hour before sunset. Learn about history, see beautiful homes, and the beauty of the Rappahannock River. $65 per person minimum of 4 people/maximum of 7 people - Approximately 1 1/4
